text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the current parking prohibitions on the west sides of Fraser Avenue, Jefferson Avenue and Pardee Avenue to provide additional parking spaces around Lamport Stadium located at 1155 King Street West. City of Toronto's Shelter Support and Housing Administration (SSHA) reviewed city properties to provide 24-hour respite service and choose a location at 1155 King Street, the parking lot of Lamport Stadium. The new structure will occupy approximately 100 parking spaces at this location.
